newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open firmer, PGMs up.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open firmer, PGMs up.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open firmer Monday, with a lower U.S. dollar overnight and the acute shortage of platinum group metals (PGMs) still seen providing support for the complex.
COMEX August gold was seen opening unchanged to up 20 cents from Friday's settlement at $345.70, after trading in a $345.80-347.30 range in overnight ACCESS trade.
In the bullion market, spot gold was quoted early at $344.15/55 an ounce, compared to the London Monday morning fix at $343.85 and the New York close Friday around $343.20/70.
COMEX warehouse gold stocks were unchanged at 974,833 ounces Friday, while silver stocks rose 1,855,752 ounces to 203,982,357 ounces.
COMEX July silver was seen opening unchanged to up 0.20 cents from Friday's settlement at 4.783, after trading a $4.780-4.800 range in ACCESS.
NYMEX July platinum was called to open up $2.00 to $3.00 an ounce from the previous close at $454.90, while NYMEX September palladium was seen up $3.00 to $5.00 an ounce.
